about_the_game:
You live in a tranquil and harmonious fruit paradise, but suddenly, the tranquility is shattered by a horde of bubble monsters that have devoured tons of fruit!
As a juice enthusiast, you decide to take revenge on the bubble monsters and reclaim the lost juice! Build your deck, summon your minion army, and engage in fierce battles against endless bubbles. Pop the bubbles, release the juice, and save the fruit world!

Game Features

  • Deckbuilding & Auto-Battles

    Select and arrange your cards to construct a powerful deck. During battle, your deck will automatically cycle through, playing cards to summon minions!

  • A Wide Variety of Cards

    Each run features a randomly generated selection of cards, allowing for diverse deck-building and powerful synergies!

  • Choose your class

    Each class has a unique set of cards with different playstyles!

  • Diverse Relics

    Enhance your abilities with a variety of powerful relics!

  • Focus on fighting

    No need to collect loot — just focus on fighting! Fight until enough enemies are killed, then head to the shop to prepare for the next wave!

short_description: Juicy Blast is a game that combines deck-building and bullet hell shooting. Players will build a deck of cards that automatically cycles and plays during battle, summon minions, and utilize the power of relics to take on endless juice-filled bubbles.
